author: Durga Prasad Acharya
review_text: I was abroad, return Nepal in Last March. I had telephone, which I do not have access now. I kept trying to call ESEWA, all the time to get access of my account which has 2 years of inactivity. Sometimes, they said to contact with social media, sometimes they want my picture with my "Nagarikata". I did everything during my 2 months of period in Nepal, but was unable to have my account. Had a terrible experience with customer service. Did not find the place to complain, so writing review here. Please make customer service professionals. I am so upset with Esewa
